mechanism: Cenobamate is a moderate CYP3A4 inducer that may increase enoxaparin metabolism, while enoxaparin's anticoagulant effects increase bleeding risk in patients on CNS-active medications; cenobamate also has mild anticoagulant properties.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding or reduced anticoagulant efficacy; consider INR/anti-Xa monitoring and possible enoxaparin dose adjustment; ensure therapeutic drug levels of cenobamate are maintained.
